decisions.title: Switch primary DB from MongoDB to PostgreSQL
decisions.author: p1
decisions.summary: Moved from MongoDB to PostgreSQL to get strong relational integrity for billing data and reduce data-consistency bugs reported by support.
decisions.impact: Cut billing-related data bugs by ~70% in the following quarter, but added 2 weeks of migration effort.

decisions.title: Adopt JWT-based auth instead of server sessions
decisions.author: p5
decisions.summary: Chose stateless JWT auth to support the new mobile app and horizontal scaling of the API layer without sticky sessions.
decisions.impact: Enabled multi-region deployment; required a token-refresh strategy that took an extra sprint to get right.

decisions.title: Deprecate the legacy /v1 reporting API
decisions.author: p3
decisions.summary: Deprecated /v1 reporting endpoints after usage analytics showed under 3% of traffic still used them, in favor of the faster /v2 aggregation pipeline.
decisions.impact: Reduced reporting server load by 40%; one enterprise client needed a 60-day extension.

decisions.title: Move CI/CD from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
decisions.author: p4
decisions.summary: Migrated pipelines to GitHub Actions to cut infra maintenance overhead and get native PR-based checks.
decisions.impact: Deploy time dropped from 18 min to 6 min; lost some custom Jenkins plugins that had to be rebuilt as Actions.

decisions.title: Introduce feature flags for gradual rollouts
decisions.author: p2
decisions.summary: Added a feature flag system after the v3.2 release caused a checkout outage with no fast way to roll back a single feature.
decisions.impact: Two subsequent risky releases were rolled back in minutes instead of hours.

meetings.title: DB Architecture Review
meetings.notes: Discussed data-consistency incidents in billing; agreed to prototype Postgres migration.

meetings.title: Mobile Launch Readiness
meetings.notes: Session-based auth flagged as blocker for mobile scaling; JWT proposed.

meetings.title: Reporting API Usage Review
meetings.notes: Analytics showed /v1 usage below deprecation threshold.

meetings.title: Infra Cost & Speed Retro
meetings.notes: Jenkins maintenance burden discussed; GitHub Actions POC approved.

meetings.title: Incident Postmortem: Checkout Outage
meetings.notes: Root cause: no rollback granularity. Action item: feature flag system.
